# Helios Dynamics - Q3 FY2026 operating review (internal)

Prepared by the office of the CFO. Figures are unaudited.

## Revenue

Q3 revenue was **$58.3M**, against $54.1M in Q2 and $61.0M in Q3 last year - the
second straight quarter of sequential growth after a soft start to the year.
Services accounted for $27.9M of the Q3 total; hardware for the remaining $30.4M.

The Meridian framework agreement contributed $11.2M and renews in March.

## Costs

Cost of goods sold was $24.6M. Operating expenses were $26.8M, of which $12.1M was
R&D headcount and $4.4M was the San Jose campus lease.

## Headcount

We ended the quarter with 604 employees, down from 641 at the end of Q2 after a
March restructuring. Attrition was 9.7%, elevated but improving.

## Commentary

The VP of Sales, Priya Raman, in the September review:

> "Services is now the story. We crossed the line where a Helios customer spends
> more on our people than on our boxes, and that revenue does not churn."

## Risks

No single customer exceeds 12% of revenue. The San Jose lease expires in
December 2026 with no renewal option; a relocation is already budgeted.
